description: Create (enqueue) a new AI faceless video from a topic. Returns immediately with a video id and status "PENDING"; the render runs asynchronously — poll get_video every 20-30 seconds until status is "COMPLETED" (playable videoUrl) or "FAILED". Costs 40 credits with the default voice (+25 for a language only ElevenLabs speaks, e.g. Persian); art style does not change the price. A short balance is refused up front with 402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS stating credits needed, available and a top-up URL. A new account with no credits that has not had its free first video gets it here instead of an error: watermarked, labelled AI-generated, up to 30 seconds, standard voice, one per account, subject to the day's availability. (Standard 30-second style; niche, art style and motion do not apply to it.) Requires the "video:create" scope on the API key. OPTIONAL AI MOTION: pass motion_scenes (0-3, default 0 = a normal video) to turn that many scenes, starting with the first, into a 5-second AI video clip instead of a still image. Price: 115 credits per motion scene EXTRA (so 1 scene = 155 credits in total with the default voice). Call quote_video first and tell the user the price before creating. Any account with enough credits can use it: there is no plan or trial limit. A clip that cannot be made falls back to the still image and its 115 credits are refunded. Content is checked first: children, real people, sexual content, protected characters and lip-sync/deepfakes are refused (422 PROMPT_BLOCKED, nothing charged). For a pasted cinematic video prompt (camera, lens, lighting, one shot) use generate_motion_clip instead: it sends the prompt as written and makes one silent clip, with no script or voice.

artStyle.description: Optional visual art style. Defaults to AUTOSHORTS (cinematic). Call list_niches for the full list.

duration.description: Target length in seconds for the multi-scene faceless video: 30, 60 or 90 (default 30).

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language code (e.g. "en", "vi", "es"). Defaults to "auto".

motion_scenes.description: Optional. How many scenes (from the first) to animate as AI clips. 115 credits each, on top of the video price. Default 0.

niche.description: Optional content niche. Call list_niches for the authoritative list with labels.

topic.description: What the video is about. The full script is AI-generated from this. e.g. "3 tiny habits that quietly change your life".

name: create_video
title: Create a video
